item.tib: tshe dbang rigs lnga'i rgyas pa'i sbyin bsregs kyi mdel thung
item.coloph: de ltar zhi rgyas mdel thung zab mo 'di/ 'gro la smin phyir thugs kyi bcud phyung ste/ las ldan gshen po rnams la bka' 'di gtad/ snyigs lnga'i mun tshogs rab tu 'khrigs pa'i skabs/ bon chos sgron ma'i 'od mdangs nus (nub) pa'i tshe/ skabs shig brda' yi yi ge legs btab ste/ zhang zhung sgo mo rtse drug byang nub mtshams/ dbal ris (ri'i) gnas tshab brag la gter du sbas/ gter srung drug la gnyer gtad dam du sdom/ phyis nges med rnal 'byor gshed bzhi los/ zab mo gter gyis skal pa rnyed pa'i smon lam thob// phyis su phug leb 'o ma stag rtse'i brag tsi rta 'dra bas (ba'i) zab mo gter gyi skal pa rnyed te (de) lo mang gsang rgya gdam (bsdams/)slar smon sras rin po che'i dgongs bzhed dang / hor sras she tsu wer zhi'i bka' gnang la 'jigs te/ ma zad grwa ha ra tshul mu drung mu khi khar wer zhi/ shel zhin sogs kyi ngo skal su (du) shog ser bod yig tu phab ste spel ba'o//
